changelog.notes: 1.0.0 First version: log, history, insights, encrypted two-phone sync, PDF export, backups, Supplement area, remembered medicines and supplements, Log this again.
1.0.1 Description is optional when an entry has a medicine or supplement, a temperature or notes.

1.1.0 Blood test area: results with units and normal ranges from the report, low/high flags, remembered ranges, trend charts in Insights, iron supplement counts between tests, blood test table and charts in the PDF.

1.2.0 Overnight sleep: Sleep entries logged in the evening default to the time they went to sleep and in the morning to the wake-up time; nights are paired into hours slept with averages, a 14-night chart with the Australian guideline band, night wakings, a short-night pattern, a sleep table in the PDF, and a sleep guideline setting.
1.2.1 One-tap "Log a night wake-up now" under Sleep (3–5 min, current time, undo). Night wake-ups are a sleep type with minutes awake, taken off the night total.
1.2.2 Concern level is optional for every entry; tap the chosen level again to clear it.

1.3.0 Supplements and medicines can list what's in them (ingredient and strength), saved with the product so the remembered button fills them in; iron inside a product counts towards the ferritin iron note; shown in History, search, PDF and text export.

1.4.0 Ready-made PediaSure Vanilla (powder) under Supplement: published Abbott AU nutrition panel (per 100 mL), scoops stepper with 5 scoops = 225 mL standard serve, nutrients scale with scoops; remembered with scoop count; its iron counts towards the ferritin note.

1.5.0 Exact time on every entry: next to the date, prefilled with now, editable later; time of day follows it automatically (picker shown only when there is no exact time); an automatic time is cleared when logging an earlier day; History, PDF and text show the exact time.

1.6.0 Choose several supplements (or medicines) from Used before and save them together: each becomes its own entry with the shared date, time and notes; amounts and scoops editable per item; one undo for the group.

1.7.0 Supplement check: daily totals of logged supplements and medicines against Australia's NRV upper levels for the chosen age group (1-3, 4-8, 9-13), warnings at 80% and 100%; iron within 2 hours of calcium/milk/PediaSure or zinc; vitamin C tip with iron; uncounted items listed; shown live in the form, as a flag on History days and as an Insights card; age group setting.

1.8.0 Shorter History: supplements or medicines given within 15 minutes of each other, and a night's wake-ups, show as one line that opens to show each entry, with "Log these again". Who logged an entry moves onto its top line, so most cards are a line shorter; notes show three lines.

1.8.1 Nature's Way Kids Smart Vita Gummies Multi-Vitamin for Fussy Eaters added as a ready-made supplement: ingredients per gummy from the label, counted in gummies, defaulting to the label dose for the age group (1 for ages 1–3, 2 otherwise), and included in the supplement check. Ready-made chips stay visible in the product form so you can switch between products. Amounts under 1 show three decimals.
